# CANDIDATE: VWAP_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sizable price deviation from VWAP coupled with a volume spike and a reversal candle predicts a mean-reversion back to VWAP. The edge exists because institutional algo activity often causes temporary VWAP deviations that get corrected when volume confirms the move is exhausted and price shows rejection.

## Mechanism

Calculate deviation = (close – VWAP)/VWAP; if |deviation| > 0.005 and volume > 2× the 20-bar average volume and the bar shows a reversal (lower wick > 0.6×body for a down‑to‑up move, upper wick > 0.6×body for an up‑to‑down move), enter long for a down‑to‑up reversal or short for an up‑to‑down reversal at the bar’s close. Exit: chart‑stop at prior swing high/low or at VWAP ± 0.5×ATR; TP1 at 1R; runner trail using chandelier exit at 2×ATR. Regime hint: VIX between 12‑20, time 10:00‑14:30; avoid extreme vol (VIX>25) and first/last 15 minutes.
